import re

MIN_PORT = 1
MAX_PORT = 65535

# 不用 str.isdigit()：它会接受 Unicode 数字（如 '٣'）
_ASCII_DIGITS = re.compile(r"[0-9]+")


def parse_port(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        raise ValueError(f"port must be str, got {type(text).__name__}")

    digits = text.strip(" ")
    if not _ASCII_DIGITS.fullmatch(digits):
        raise ValueError(f"invalid port: {text!r}")

    value = int(digits.lstrip("0") or "0")
    if not MIN_PORT <= value <= MAX_PORT:
        raise ValueError(f"port out of range {MIN_PORT}-{MAX_PORT}: {text!r}")
    return value

import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import parse_port  # noqa: E402


class ParsePortValidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_boundaries(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("1"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65535"), 65535)

    def test_just_inside_boundaries(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("2"), 2)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65534"), 65534)

    def test_common_ports(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("80"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("443"), 443)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("8080"), 8080)

    def test_leading_zeros(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0080"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("00000001"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0065535"), 65535)

    def test_long_zero_padding(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0" * 5000 + "443"), 443)

    def test_surrounding_ascii_spaces(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 80"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("80 "), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("   65535   "), 65535)

    def test_returns_int(self):
        self.assertIs(type(parse_port("22")), int)


class ParsePortInvalidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertRejects(self, value):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError, msg=repr(value)):
            parse_port(value)

def parse_port(text):
    # ==================== 类型与格式校验 ====================
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        raise ValueError(f"端口必须是字符串: {type(text).__name__}")
    digits = text.strip(" ")
    if not digits or not digits.isascii() or not digits.isdigit():
        raise ValueError(f"端口格式非法: {text!r}")

    # ==================== 范围校验 ====================
    port = int(digits)
    if not MIN_PORT <= port <= MAX_PORT:
        raise ValueError(f"端口超出范围 {MIN_PORT}-{MAX_PORT}: {text!r}")
    return port

_ASCII_DIGITS = frozenset("0123456789")
_PORT_MIN = 1
_PORT_MAX = 65535


def parse_port(text):
    # ==================== 端口解析 ====================
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        raise ValueError("端口必须是字符串")
    # 只去除 ASCII 空格，制表符、换行等保持原样并视为非法
    body = text.strip(" ")
    if not body or any(ch not in _ASCII_DIGITS for ch in body):
        raise ValueError(f"端口格式非法: {text!r}")
    # 先去掉前导零再转换，避免超长前导零触发 int() 的位数上限
    port = int(body.lstrip("0") or "0")
    if not _PORT_MIN <= port <= _PORT_MAX:
        raise ValueError(f"端口超出范围 1-65535: {text!r}")
    return port

import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import parse_port


class ParsePortValidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lower_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("1"), 1)

    def test_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65535"), 65535)

    def test_just_inside_boundaries(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("2"), 2)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65534"), 65534)

    def test_common_port(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("8080"), 8080)

    def test_leading_zeros_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0080"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("00000000000000001"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0000065535"), 65535)

    def test_surrounding_spaces_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("  443  "), 443)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 1"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65535 "), 65535)

    def test_returns_int(self):
        self.assertIs(type(parse_port("22")), int)


class ParsePortInvalidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertRejected(self, value):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_port(value)

    def test_zero_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("0")
        self.assertRejected("000")

    def test_just_above_upper_boundary_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("65536")
        self.assertRejected("0065536")

    def test_large_values_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("99999")
        self.assertRejected("9" * 400)

    def test_empty_and_space_only_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("")
        self.assertRejected(" ")
        self.assertRejected("   ")

    def test_signs_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("+80")
        self.assertRejected("-80")
        self.assertRejected("+0")

    def test_tabs_and_newlines_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("\t80")
        self.assertRejected("80\t")
        self.assertRejected("\n80")
        self.assertRejected("80\n")
        self.assertRejected("80\r\n")
        self.assertRejected("8\t0")

    def test_inner_spaces_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("8 0")

    def test_non_ascii_digits_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("٤٤٤")  # Arabic-Indic digits
        self.assertRejected("８０")  # fullwidth 8 0
        self.assertRejected("²")  # superscript two

    def test_non_ascii_space_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected(" 80")  # no-break space
        self.assertRejected("　80")  # ideographic space

    def test_decimal_points_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("80.0")
        self.assertRejected(".80")
        self.assertRejected("80.")

    def test_exponent_and_underscores_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("8e1")
        self.assertRejected("8_0")

    def test_letters_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("80a")
        self.assertRejected("http")

    def test_non_string_inputs_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected(None)
        self.assertRejected(80)
        self.assertRejected(80.0)
        self.assertRejected(b"80")
        self.assertRejected(["80"])
        self.assertRejected(True)

# src

```
src/
├── CLAUDE.md        本文件：目录职责与模块说明
└── solution.cjs     异步重试工具 retry()，唯一导出 { retry }
```

## solution.cjs

- 职责：以固定延迟重试一个异步操作，直到成功、次数耗尽或 `shouldRetry` 判定不可重试。
- 入参：`retry(operation, { attempts, delayMs, sleep, shouldRetry })`
  - `attempts`：正整数，包含首次调用；非法值返回 rejected Promise（`RangeError`）。
  - `delayMs`：默认 `0`；每次重试前 `await sleep(delayMs)`。
  - `sleep`：默认基于 `setTimeout`；测试中注入假实现以保证确定性。
  - `shouldRetry`：默认恒为 `true`；仅对已 reject 且返回真值的错误重试。
- 语义：成功则返回首个成功值；耗尽或不可重试时原样抛出最后一个错误对象。sleep 只发生在两次尝试之间。
- 依赖：无外部依赖，不依赖其他模块。被 `test/retry.test.js` 覆盖。

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src"))

from solution import topological_order  # noqa: E402


def assert_valid_order(test, nodes, edges, order):
    test.assertEqual(sorted(order), sorted(nodes))
    test.assertEqual(len(order), len(set(order)))
    position = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(order)}
    for before, after in edges:
        test.assertLess(position[before], position[after])


class TopologicalOrderTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_graph(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order([], []), [])

    def test_isolated_nodes_are_included(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        order = topological_order(nodes, [])
        assert_valid_order(self, nodes, [], order)

    def test_chain(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            topological_order(["c", "a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]),
            ["a", "b", "c"],
        )

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        assert_valid_order(self, nodes, edges, topological_order(nodes, edges))

    def test_disconnected_components(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "x", "y", "z"]
        edges = [("b", "a"), ("y", "z")]
        assert_valid_order(self, nodes, edges, topological_order(nodes, edges))

    def test_three_node_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b", "c"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "a")])

    def test_two_node_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a"], [("a", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_among_other_nodes_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "b")])

    def test_cycle_unreachable_from_sources_raises(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "b")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_duplicate_edges_do_not_create_false_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("a", "b")]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b"])

    def test_duplicate_edges_with_cycle_still_raise(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_inputs_are_not_mutated(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        nodes_copy = list(nodes)
        edges_copy = list(edges)
        topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, nodes_copy)
        self.assertEqual(edges, edges_copy)

    def test_accepts_tuple_and_list_edges(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [["a", "b"], ("b", "c")]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b", "c"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src"))

from solution import topological_order  # noqa: E402


def assert_valid(test, nodes, edges, order):
    test.assertEqual(sorted(order), sorted(nodes))
    test.assertEqual(len(order), len(set(order)))
    position = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(order)}
    for a, b in edges:
        test.assertLess(position[a], position[b], f"{a} must precede {b}")


class TopologicalOrderTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_graph(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order([], []), [])

    def test_isolated_nodes_are_included(self):
        nodes = ["x", "y", "z"]
        order = topological_order(nodes, [])
        assert_valid(self, nodes, [], order)

    def test_chain(self):
        nodes = ["c", "a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["d", "c", "b", "a"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        assert_valid(self, nodes, edges, topological_order(nodes, edges))

    def test_mixed_isolated_and_connected(self):
        nodes = ["lone", "a", "b", "other"]
        edges = [("a", "b")]
        assert_valid(self, nodes, edges, topological_order(nodes, edges))

    def test_multiple_roots_and_sinks(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"]
        edges = [("a", "c"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "d"), ("c", "e")]
        assert_valid(self, nodes, edges, topological_order(nodes, edges))

    def test_duplicate_edges_do_not_create_false_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("a", "b")]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b"])

    def test_duplicate_edges_in_larger_graph(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_self_loop_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a"], [("a", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_on_isolated_node_in_larger_graph_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "b")])

    def test_two_node_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_cycle_with_tail_raises(self):
        nodes = ["root", "a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("root", "a"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_cycle_plus_duplicate_edges_still_raises(self):
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], edges)

    def test_inputs_not_mutated(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        nodes_before = list(nodes)
        edges_before = list(edges)
        topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, nodes_before)
        self.assertEqual(edges, edges_before)

    def test_accepts_list_edges(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        edges = [["a", "b"]]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b"])

    def test_large_chain_no_recursion_limit(self):
        n = 50_000
        nodes = [str(i) for i in range(n)]
        edges = [(nodes[i], nodes[i + 1]) for i in range(n - 1)]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), nodes)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import topological_order  # noqa: E402


def assert_valid_order(test, nodes, edges, order):
    test.assertEqual(sorted(order), sorted(nodes))
    position = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(order)}
    for before, after in edges:
        test.assertLess(position[before], position[after])


class TopologicalOrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def check(self, nodes, edges):
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        assert_valid_order(self, nodes, edges, order)
        return order

    def test_empty_graph(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order([], []), [])

    def test_isolated_nodes_are_all_included(self):
        self.check(["a", "b", "c"], [])

    def test_single_chain(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(["a", "b", "c"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_chain_given_in_reverse_node_order(self):
        self.check(["c", "b", "a"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")])

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        order = self.check(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(order[0], "a")
        self.assertEqual(order[-1], "d")

    def test_isolated_nodes_mixed_with_edges(self):
        self.check(["x", "a", "b", "y"], [("b", "a")])

    def test_duplicate_edges_do_not_create_false_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("a", "b")]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b"])

    def test_duplicate_edges_in_larger_graph(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("a", "c"), ("a", "c")]
        self.check(nodes, edges)

    def test_two_node_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_longer_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b", "c"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "a")])

    def test_cycle_not_involving_all_nodes_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b", "c", "d"], [("a", "b"), ("c", "d"), ("d", "c")])

    def test_self_loop_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a"], [("a", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_with_other_nodes_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "b")])

    def test_inputs_are_not_mutated(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("a", "b")]
        nodes_copy = list(nodes)
        edges_copy = list(edges)
        topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, nodes_copy)
        self.assertEqual(edges, edges_copy)

    def test_inputs_not_mutated_on_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(edges, [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_large_chain(self):
        n = 5000
        nodes = [str(i) for i in range(n)]
        edges = [(str(i), str(i + 1)) for i in range(n - 1)]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), nodes)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import topological_order


def is_valid_order(order, nodes, edges):
    if sorted(order) != sorted(nodes) or len(order) != len(nodes):
        return False
    position = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(order)}
    return all(position[a] < position[b] for a, b in edges)


class TopologicalOrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_no_nodes(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order([], []), [])

    def test_isolated_nodes_are_included_once(self):
        nodes = ["x", "y", "z"]
        order = topological_order(nodes, [])
        self.assertEqual(order, ["x", "y", "z"])

    def test_chain(self):
        nodes = ["c", "a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["d", "b", "c", "a"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertTrue(is_valid_order(order, nodes, edges))

    def test_isolated_nodes_mixed_with_edges(self):
        nodes = ["p", "q", "lone", "r"]
        edges = [("r", "q"), ("q", "p")]
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertTrue(is_valid_order(order, nodes, edges))
        self.assertIn("lone", order)

    def test_duplicate_edges_do_not_create_false_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("a", "b")]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_two_node_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_longer_cycle_raises(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "d"), ("d", "b")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_cycle_alongside_valid_part_raises(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "x", "y"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("x", "y"), ("y", "x")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_self_loop_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a"], [("a", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_with_other_edges_raises(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, [("a", "b"), ("b", "b")])

    def test_inputs_not_mutated(self):
        nodes = ["c", "b", "a", "iso"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        nodes_before = list(nodes)
        edges_before = list(edges)
        topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, nodes_before)
        self.assertEqual(edges, edges_before)

    def test_accepts_tuple_edges(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, (("a", "b"),)), ["a", "b"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


def make_conn(names):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
    conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)", list(enumerate(names, 1)))
    return conn


def names_of(rows):
    return [name for _, name in rows]


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_percent_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn(["100% pure", "100x pure", "100"])
        self.assertEqual(names_of(search(conn, "100%", 10)), ["100% pure"])

    def test_underscore_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a_c", "abc", "a_"])
        self.assertEqual(names_of(search(conn, "a_", 10)), ["a_", "a_c"])

    def test_backslash_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a\\b", "axb", "a\\"])
        self.assertEqual(names_of(search(conn, "a\\", 10)), ["a\\", "a\\b"])

    def test_backslash_before_wildcard_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn(["x\\%y", "x%y", "xzy"])
        self.assertEqual(names_of(search(conn, "x\\%", 10)), ["x\\%y"])

    def test_empty_prefix_matches_all(self):
        conn = make_conn(["b", "a"])
        self.assertEqual(names_of(search(conn, "", 10)), ["a", "b"])

    def test_sql_injection_attempt_is_treated_as_text(self):
        conn = make_conn(["alice", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "' OR 1=1 --", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(names_of(search(conn, "alice", 10)), ["alice"])

    def test_ordering_is_name_then_id(self):
        conn = make_conn(["bob", "al", "al", "ab"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "", 10), [(4, "ab"), (2, "al"), (3, "al"), (1, "bob")])

    def test_limit_is_applied(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a1", "a2", "a3"])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "a", 2)), 2)

    def test_limit_below_one_is_clamped_to_one(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a1", "a2"])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "a", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "a", -5)), 1)

    def test_limit_above_hundred_is_clamped_to_hundred(self):
        conn = make_conn([f"user{i:03d}" for i in range(150)])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "user", 1000)), 100)

    def test_rejects_bool_limit(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "a", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "a", False)

    def test_rejects_non_integer_limit(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a"])
        for bad in ["5", 5.0, None, [5]]:
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(conn, "a", bad)

    def test_rejects_non_string_prefix(self):
        conn = make_conn(["a"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, None, 10)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        self.conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
        rows = [
            (1, "100% done"),
            (2, "100 done"),
            (3, "1000"),
            (4, "a_c"),
            (5, "abc"),
            (6, "a\\b"),
            (7, "axb"),
            (8, "bob"),
            (9, "bob"),
            (10, "bobby"),
        ]
        self.conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users VALUES (?, ?)", rows)

    def tearDown(self):
        self.conn.close()

    def test_percent_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "100%", 10), [(1, "100% done")])

    def test_underscore_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "a_", 10), [(4, "a_c")])

    def test_backslash_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "a\\", 10), [(6, "a\\b")])

    def test_wildcards_do_not_match_everything(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "%", 10), [(1, "100% done")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "_", 10), [])

    def test_sql_injection_attempt_is_inert(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "' OR '1'='1", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "x'; DROP TABLE users; --", 10), [])

        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "5%", 10), [(1, "50% off")][:0] + [(1, "50% off")])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "%", 10), [(4, "%raw")])

    def test_underscore_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a_b", "axb", "a_"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a_", 10), [(3, "a_"), (1, "a_b")])

    def test_backslash_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a\\b", "ab", "a\\"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a\\", 10), [(3, "a\\"), (1, "a\\b")])

    def test_sql_injection_string_is_just_text(self):
        conn = make_db(["alice", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "x' OR '1'='1", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "' OR 1=1 --", 10), [])

    def test_limit_clamped_to_minimum_of_one(self):
        conn = make_db(["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "", 0), [(1, "a")])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "", -5), [(1, "a")])

    def test_limit_clamped_to_maximum_of_100(self):
        conn = make_db([f"user{i:03d}" for i in range(150)])
        rows = search(conn, "user", 1000)
        self.assertEqual(len(rows), 100)
        self.assertEqual(rows[0], (1, "user000"))

    def test_rejects_bool_limit(self):
        conn = make_db(["a"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "", False)

    def test_rejects_non_integer_limit(self):
        conn = make_db(["a"])
        for bad in (2.0, "5", None, [1]):
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(conn, "", bad)

    def test_rejects_non_string_prefix(self):
        conn = make_db(["a"])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(conn, None, 5)

from collections.abc import Iterable


def decode_chunks(chunks: Iterable[bytes]) -> str:
    # final=True 时若仍残留不完整的多字节序列，会抛出 UnicodeDecodeError
    decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder("utf-8")(errors="strict")
    parts = [decoder.decode(chunk) for chunk in chunks]
    parts.append(decoder.decode(b"", final=True))
    return "".join(parts)

import os
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src"))

from solution import resolve_upload


class ResolveUploadTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(tmp.cleanup)
        base = Path(tmp.name).resolve()
        self.root = base / "root"
        self.sibling = base / "sibling"
        self.lookalike = base / "root-old"
        for d in (self.root, self.sibling, self.lookalike):
            d.mkdir()
        (self.root / "inside.txt").write_text("ok")
        (self.sibling / "secret.txt").write_text("secret")

    def test_existing_file_inside_root(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            resolve_upload(self.root, "inside.txt"), self.root / "inside.txt"
        )

    def test_nested_nonexistent_path_is_returned_without_creating_files(self):
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/new.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "a" / "b" / "new.txt")
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "a").exists())

    def test_absolute_path_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.sibling / "secret.txt"))

    def test_root_itself_rejected(self):
        for supplied in ("", ".", "a/.."):
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_traversal_into_sibling_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../sibling/secret.txt")

    def test_nested_traversal_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "a/../../sibling/secret.txt")

    def test_string_prefix_lookalike_directory_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../root-old/file.txt")

    def test_symlink_to_sibling_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling, self.root / "escape")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "escape/secret.txt")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "escape")

    def test_dangling_symlink_to_outside_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling / "missing.txt", self.root / "dangling")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "dangling")

    def test_symlink_inside_root_allowed(self):
        os.symlink(self.root / "inside.txt", self.root / "alias")
        self.assertEqual(
            resolve_upload(self.root, "alias"), self.root / "inside.txt"
        )

    def test_symlink_loop_rejected(self):
        os.symlink("loop", self.root / "loop")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "loop")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from pathlib import Path


def resolve_upload(root: Path, supplied: str) -> Path:
    # ==================== 解析上传路径 ====================
    # 带盘符或根的路径会让 root / supplied 直接忽略 root
    candidate = Path(supplied)
    if candidate.anchor:
        raise ValueError(f"absolute path not allowed: {supplied!r}")

    base = Path(root).resolve(strict=True)
    # resolve() 跟随已存在的符号链接并折叠 ".."，不存在的尾部分量原样保留
    target = (base / candidate).resolve()

    if target == base:
        raise ValueError("target must not be the root directory")
    if base not in target.parents:
        raise ValueError(f"path escapes root: {supplied!r}")
    return target

from pathlib import Path


def resolve_upload(root, supplied):
    """Return the resolved path for an untrusted relative upload path under root.

    Nothing is created on disk. This check is not atomic with later use of the path.
    """
    root_path = Path(root).resolve(strict=True)
    candidate = Path(supplied)
    if candidate.anchor:
        raise ValueError("absolute paths are not allowed")

    target = (root_path / candidate).resolve()
    if target == root_path:
        raise ValueError("upload target must not be the root directory")
    if not target.is_relative_to(root_path):
        raise ValueError("upload path escapes the root directory")
    return target
